stage: Stage 21 independent strong supervised benchmark decision

decision_policy.D: The fixed ensemble is materially stronger than HGB.
decision_policy.C: D is false and a selected individual benchmark is materially stronger than HGB.
decision_policy.A: D/C are false and HGB is materially stronger than both selected strongest individual references.
decision_policy.B: D/C/A are false and LightGBM is boosting-equivalent to HGB.

paper_implication: HGB and LightGBM cluster within the frozen practical margins, supporting the interpretation that AMP's customer representation, rather than a uniquely favorable classifier, carries the development result.
literature_claim_boundary: Motivates strong tabular baselines only; no protocol-equivalent published comparison and no state-of-the-art claim.
next_step_reason: Stage 19 found strong feature-family redundancy and Stage 21 finds classifier-level boosting equivalence, jointly motivating one pre-specified simplification test rather than more model hunting.
